input.summary: Delete the one-way 18-month non-solicit/no-engage restriction on Customer.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted § 12.4: it binds only us, runs eighteen months, covers anyone Vendor employed at any time (not just personnel involved in the Services), bars engagement as well as solicitation, and has no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out; it also contradicts § 12.3. Our position is no non-solicit on Customer, though we could accept a mutual clause limited to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs and no no-hire.
